workarounds.symptom: An App created by setup github cannot run forge jobs: the branch-protection check needs Administration: read

Target files: worker/src/comment-tables.mjs, worker/src/doctor.mjs, worker/src/forgejo-host.mjs. Target files: implementations/cli/smoke/command-kernel.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/src/commands/update.ts, packages/workspace/src/updates.ts. workarounds.symptom: [BUG] DurableAgent.recover() swallows processor-resolution errors and continues the recovered run with no processors

Target files: packages/core/src/agent/durable/durable-agent.ts, packages/core/vitest.isolated-tests.ts, packages/core/src/agent/durable/__tests__/durable-agent-recover-processor-failure.test.ts. > Opened by @wardpeet (Ref: https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pull/29153)

workarounds.symptom: OIDC: a failed discovery is cached for one hour, so every login keeps failing until the cache expires or n8n restarts
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(core): Clear cached OIDC configuration when discovery fails. Target files: packages/cli/src/modules/sso-oidc/oidc.service.ee.ts, packages/cli/src/modules/sso-oidc/__tests__/oidc.service.ee.test.ts. This change ensures that `OidcService` resets its cached configuration when identity provider (IdP) discovery fails, allowing subsequent login requests to retry discovery. (Ref: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/pull/43075)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: `exited (-1)` status when the job's process is killed by a signal
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Report signals in job exit status. Target files: runner/internal/runner/executor/executor.go, runner/internal/runner/executor/executor_test.go, src/dstack/_internal/core/models/runs.py. When a signal killed the job's process, the runner reported exit status -1, the value of os.ProcessState.ExitCode() for any signal, and the job was shown as `exited (-1)`. (Ref: https://github.com/dstackai/dstack/pull/4490)

workarounds.symptom: fix(cli): refuse a destination link on the `init --out` and skill-library seed write paths
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): refuse a destination link on the init write paths. Target files: agentdescent/cli.py, tests/test_cli_skill_library_seed.py, changelog.d/1008-dest-link.md. `init` seeds a skill library, writes `--out`, and (with `--agent opencode --model --base-url`) writes `<stem>.opencode-providers.json`. All three took a link planted at the destination: the spec was written outside the target tree and the `.bak-N` copy inside it held the bytes of the file the link pointed at. `apply --to` already refuses that shape (#977). (Ref: https://github.com/ThinkFlowLab/agentdescent/pull/1012)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: Skip running the SFT Flash Attention xfails on torch versions that leak checkpoint hooks. Target files: tests/test_sft_trainer.py. workarounds.symptom: batch-greet 对结果未知的招呼自动重发一次，并输出 ok:true 丢失 replay_safe
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: 批量招呼不再重发结果未知的发送 (#984). Target files: src/boss_agent_cli/commands/greet.py, tests/test_greet_extended.py, CHANGELOG.md. `batch-greet` 把所有非风控异常统一「sleep 后重试一次」，**包括 `ACTION_UNCONFIRMED`**。该码的语义是「请求已发出、响应中断、结果未知」，平台层在 `__cli_error_details__` 里明确 `outcome: unknown` / `replay_safe: false`（`api/browser_client.py:855-863`），`platforms/zhipin.py:55-61` 原样保留。对结果未知的写操作自动重发一次招呼，违反仓库「结果未知的写操作禁止自动重试」的硬边界。 (Ref: https://github.com/can4hou6joeng4/boss-agent-cli/pull/985)

workarounds.symptom: bug(web-shell): an unconfirmed send in another conversation disables the composer instead of only blocking submit
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(web-shell): keep the composer editable for a foreign unconfirmed send. Target files: packages/web-shell/client/e2e/managed-draft-retry.spec.ts, packages/web-shell/client/hooks/useComposerCore.ts, packages/web-shell/client/components/ChatEditor.tsx. An unconfirmed send no longer locks the composer of conversations it does not belong to. The composer is now replaced by the retry/discard banner only in the conversation that owns the pending record; every other conversation stays editable — typing, pasting and drafting all... (Ref: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/17140)
